### Torn-read hardening for the scanner
- id: `rm-254` | track: reliability | priority: 45.0 | status: candidate
- signals: reliability.torn_read:discovery parses whole files mid-scan while the cache fingerprints by (size, mtime) alone (session_cache.rs is_fresh) — a writer rewriting a transcript underneath the scan yields a torn parse or a poisoned fingerprint; upstream evidence: Claude Code CHANGELOG 2.1.288 fixed 'resume occasionally loading a transcript cut short when the same session rewrote the file during the load' — upstream treats the race as real

- signals: platform.guard_stub:statusline.rs::L409-417 — journal_descriptor_is_live's cfg(not(unix)) arm returns true unconditionally, and its comment ("The temp-file rename is a Unix journal pattern; elsewhere the advisory lock on the open descriptor is the whole protocol") misstates the code it annotates: compaction rewrites the journal via write_private_exclusive (session_cache.rs:1049) whose fs::rename runs on ALL platforms. On Windows (first-class target: winget/ + cargo-wix), a writer that opened the journal before a compactor's rename locks the orphaned stream, is told "live", and its append vanishes — the exact silent capture-loss class rm-166 fixed on Unix via inode compare (assess 48871b27 F1)
- acceptance: (a) non-unix arm compares file identity (Windows file_index via MetadataExt, or equivalent) OR compaction refuses the rename-based protocol on non-unix; (b) the arm's comment matches the code it annotates; (c) red-first: a cfg-gated test pinning the guard semantics where compilable, plus compile coverage via the cross-OS matrix port (see the linux-only-tests section fold, upstream #303 source 36b943f); (d) full suite green on the primary lane
- evidence: assess 48871b27 F1 at base 97f06d43 (anchors re-read this cycle: statusline.rs:384-417 and :438-465; session_cache.rs:1049); no test pins the arm today; landed precedent for the Unix side = rm-166

  L1 tag-namespace-relative CI gates: `git tag --merged HEAD` gates flip red on unchanged trees when wholesale tag fetches move shared refs; prevention = diff the tag namespace before blaming the delta; remedy = the designed no-changelog-section marker with reasons from each tag's own commit (landed for every inherited tag v0.7.2-v0.8.0 + provenance comment, CHANGELOG.md:324-340 in the merged tree — the block HEAD already carries, recorded 2026-10-05 by this run's full_tests b163e538); never delete shared tag refs; treat assess-time clean-CI verdicts as tag-relative.
  L1(e) DELEGATION/DECISION RECORD for the commit gate (review F2): full_tests b163e538 landed that CHANGELOG marker block OUTSIDE the stewardship-approved rm-511/rm-512 batch to green check-plugin-version.sh — content verified accurate by the review (each marker's commit hash/subject matches `git log -1` on its tag; v0.7.5 is a genuine re-tag of v0.7.4's 2462045) and the marker is the rm-303-designed remedy, but the fleet constraint pinned 2026-10-06 from sibling run 6aaf51aaa919 holds the CI-faithful state is the red one and forbids editing CHANGELOG inside a validation gate (reconciliation owned by the rm-018/rm-163 lineage); two sibling runs now hold opposite resolutions of the same hazard — the commit gate must CONSCIOUSLY ADJUDICATE: ship the block with this decision record, or strip it and accept the red gate.
  L2 stale-dirty sibling worktrees: file-level overlap does not equal live overlap (run-27253dd5/run-e602bb69 hold landed content); verify provenance vs the sibling's base; never cross-copy dirty trees.
  L3 numeral double-mint bands (3rd instance: rm-511/512 vs run-250cfd64, 3 min apart, disjoint subjects): precedence by mint mtime; cite SUBJECT+title everywhere; integration renumbers-by-title.
  L4 decode-fixture rule: project_decode_status returns NotConsulted for cwd-bearing journals (insights.rs matches on session.cwd non-empty); the encoded dir is the FULL absolute path with '/' mapped to '-' — decode tests must strip cwd and mirror insights.rs:790-845 encoding or silently test nothing.
  L5 validation-block emptiness: full_command/changed_testable_surfaces derive from committed state and are blind to a run's uncommitted delta — run the repository-authoritative composite and say so in trigger_reason.
  L6 (added at review-fix re-land) recorded-verification integrity + external rewind hazard: the original compound PhaseResult recorded file-state verification (banner/lessons probes, +29 ROADMAP lines, 512/-23) that the tree never held — ROADMAP.md sat at its implement-phase mtime 2026-10-05T16:07:11Z with the delta absent, and the sweep recurred after a first review-fix landing (that attempt's own postfix-verify artifact shows all probes 0, contradicting its recorded CLEAN). Prevention: every tree-state claim must be backed by a read-back captured AFTER the write (mtime + diff-stat + probe counts from the same shell that made the edit), and any later phase consuming a compound/roadmap deliverable must re-probe the tree instead of trusting the prior PhaseResult.

<!-- cycle-3 lessons & prevention rules (2026-10-07, run 5abd9bb74b9e compound 44ba76d4, repository-maintenance 8dc71851 cycle 3; pre-review — distilled from implement e3d9e9f0, targeted_tests 860c4919, full_tests aee7a7ae; full texts + verification in the compound record):
  L1 libtest child-reexec filter trap: a child process re-exec'ing the test binary must filter by BARE test-name substring; '--exact' + module_path!() can NEVER match because module_path!() carries the crate-name prefix libtest does not use — a mismatched child runs zero tests, exits 0, and false-greens the parent's assertion (hit on the journal race fixture before diagnosis).
  L2 vacuous race fixtures: a concurrency fixture must COUNT the racing operations and assert count > 0 (the compactor-swaps marker) — a degenerate run (compactor erroring every cycle) otherwise passes vacuously; the first three RED runs of journal_appends_survive_parallel_compaction were vacuous for exactly this reason.
  L3 printf|grep -q under `set -euo pipefail`: grep -q exits on first match and closes the pipe while printf may still hold buffered bytes → printf takes SIGPIPE(141) → pipefail fails the pipeline → a '!'-guarded presence check reports a PRESENT marker as MISSING (~1/10 under load; caught with bash -x showing gate_code containing '--fail-under-health 80' while the FAIL branch ran). Remedy: grep here-strings, no pipe. Fixed at both live sites in scripts/ci/check-example-workflows.sh (60/60 soak). Residual same-pattern site: check-release-surfaces.sh:124 — inert today (no Go files flow through it), next-cycle hardening candidate.
  L4 rc masking through pipes: piping a gate script's output through `tail` and reading $? reports TAIL's rc — both real full_tests failures first showed as rc=0; capture rc before pipes or use PIPESTATUS.
  L5 MSRV bump protocol: raising rust-version requires the companion mirror in scripts/ci/check-cargo-manifests.sh's expected-manifest table (this cycle 1.88→1.89 for std File::lock) plus a CHANGELOG note at the commit gate; the manifests gate fails otherwise.
  L6 machine-contention triage: a 600s timeout on a suite that is green in isolation (uptime load avg 34.87, sibling rustc in the process table since 04:36) is MACHINE LOAD, not a fixture hang — prove it via no leftover test processes / no orphaned temp fixture dirs + isolated re-runs before touching code; later gates should use per-command bounded timeouts and isolated invocations under load.
  L7 hand-me-down pin verification: prioritize 05bf0bac carried 'app.rs:2164-2181 resolve_project' — impossible in every tree version (app.rs is 1820 lines at base, canonical HEAD and origin; resolve_project is core insights.rs:210-244) — and a nonexistent SessionIdx type; the stewardship redo ecb63e07 caught both first-hand and corrected the change-unit seams. Every seam pin must be re-read at the phase that acts on it; the redo's corrections supersede the plan's.
  L8 dead-attempt triage (two instances this cycle): roadmap 23ee5e69 (pings-only event log, no typed result, zero durable tree work, postimage never written) → REDO from scratch, adopting only the plan with numerals re-derived live; stewardship 6500b0de (session_reaped at harvest, orphaned result JSON) → redo with every pin re-verified first-hand. Never adopt unverified durable-output claims from dead attempts.
  L9 census-from-artifact rule: def-row totals and max numerals must be re-derived from the artifact bytes (git object or postimage, `^- id: ` lines) at every phase that consumes them — this cycle's roadmap + prioritize narratives and the mint-census doc carried "base 228 def rows / max rm-608 / def 228→236", which are ### HEADING counts (base 228 headings vs 214 def rows; postimage 236 headings vs 222 def rows) plus a banner-prose numeral (rm-608 in a cycle-1 banner; true def-max rm-600). Nothing material broke because numeral allocation was claim-sweep-based and the patch→base→postimage chain is byte-identical — but wall accounting, next-free math and prioritize denominators must never be copied from a prior narrative.
  Next-cycle context (pre-review): LEAD rm-685 (origin-based cycle; compose with landed rm-389's rewritten id machinery; history.rs lives in agenttrace-CORE) / rm-687 (re-verify dup-arm + replace-vs-max against origin's rewritten parser.rs @@-358/-402) / rm-689-692 external-fixture procurement (Vibe, Antigravity app, codex session_index; rm-692 composes with landed rm-575); residuals app.rs:1424 top_driver and check-release-surfaces.sh:124; fleet claim ceiling rm-736 → next free rm-737 after a fresh live census. -->

### Config parser truncates unquoted values at an embedded #
- id: `rm-918` | track: developer-experience | priority: 32.0 | status: implemented (2026-10-10, run d02291d0efbb cycle 1 compound b24ad78b; pre-review evidence, commit gate pending)
- signals: correctness.bare_hash_truncation:crates/agenttrace-cli/src/config.rs::L226-237 (strip_comment cuts the line at the first `#` even when embedded mid-value in an unquoted bare scalar — `pricing_file = /tmp/probe#x.toml` parses as `/tmp/probe`), truthfulness.loud_promise:README.md::L129-131 ("Unknown keys, tables, arrays, and non-positive budgets are rejected with the file, line number, and key — a typo never silently does nothing" — the config surface's own loud-failure contract; a path silently losing its `#`-tail contradicts it; the README's grammar examples QUOTE their values, so documented usage is safe — the hazard is bare scalars), live PoC assess a38c3665 (release binary): poc-config/agenttrace.toml with an embedded-`#` pricing_file → `agenttrace --config poc-config/agenttrace.toml --doctor` renders "pricing_file: /tmp/probe (config file)" — truncation observable on a real run, no warning emitted
- acceptance: the implementing lane decides and records ONE of: (a) `#` opens a comment only at line start or after whitespace — an embedded `#` stays part of a bare value; or (b) values containing `#` must be quoted and an unquoted bare scalar containing `#` is rejected LOUDLY (file:line + the truncated-vs-written value) per the loud-failure promise; goldens pin an embedded-`#` config end-to-end through --doctor/pricing resolution (accepted value under (a), rejection message under (b)); full suite green; conductor validation digest recorded at the gates
- evidence: assess a38c3665 PoC (delegate/a38c3665a8d2450eacb132b187737ffc-scratch/poc-config/agenttrace.toml + the --doctor output quoted in findings.md); goldens; validation digest

- 2026-10-10: EXECUTED cycle 1 (run d02291d0efbb, implement 17d6a95a @ base eafbb592 uncommitted; targeted e56750ed + full a0ea1af7 green, NOT re-run at compound) — DECISION (a) TOML-parity recorded per stewardship 6fe41d11: strip_comment opens a comment only at line start or directly after whitespace (outside quotes); an embedded '#' stays part of an unquoted bare value; quoted '#' always literal.
